description:
**If you do something dirty with your childhood friend, your grades will go up?!**

So-Ra, who grew up under a controlling mother, enters the Korea University Medical School as her mother wished, but she feels helpless as she falls behind her peers. Then, she accidentally sees a secret sex scene of her peers, and things start to shake up So-Ra's daily life... Suddenly, her childhood friend Chan-Hee and her mysterious senior, who is a very close friend, show up.

*"This isn't the college life I thought it would be...?!!"*

A cheeky and sassy love comedy that hits Sora, a freshman at Korea University♥

(Source: Mr. Blue, translated)
